notes: PLAY OF THE GAME: your best multi-kill of the match (2 or more kills close together; headshots and long shots count extra) plays from your own eyes before the scoreboard - the soldiers you got walk their real paths and drop. Click or press any key to skip; turn it off in Settings > GAMEPLAY.
FINISHERS: melee someone from behind (or catch them not looking) for a takedown - you swing in, the gun thrusts, they go down hard. +100 and one of three names: ROLLED UP, PUFF PUFF PASS OUT, SMOKED.
WEAPON INSPECT (F / D-pad down) now depends on the gun: pistols spin, shotguns pump and turn, snipers and marksman rifles look down the scope, SMGs flip, rifles and LMGs turn over and check the mag.
